needs.context: The following is a description of a funny cartoon for the New Yorker Caption Contest Description: A man is exiting an elevator with a suitcase, looking surprised. Inside the elevator, a duck wearing a pilot's hat and badge is standing in front of two other surprised people. Which of the following captions is the funniest?
